title: The Last Detention
author: Vesper Brightwater
blurb: Astrid Quintana, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must expose what the school board buried before prom.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
